promptTemplate:
Create a NEW illustration of a small traditional Korean detached guest annex (별당, byeoldang) in exactly the same illustrated-map style as the attached reference building (a hanok estate map: LOW-POLY FACETED planes -- every surface is broken into flat angular colour facets like folded paper, NO drawn outlines, matte finish, subtle hanji paper grain, warm wood/stone colours, top-left lighting, seen straight from the front in a slightly elevated view -- same camera as the reference).

The building: a single small one-story hanok with its own low stone platform and steps, wooden post-and-beam frame, lattice-door front wall, and a modest hipped tile roof -- visibly smaller and simpler than the reference building (this is a guest annex, not the main house), with a small covered wooden veranda (toenmaru) along the front.

Do not redraw the reference building; it is for style, palette, camera and lighting only. Show ONLY the byeoldang, fully finished, centred in the frame.

Flat pure #00FF00 chroma-key green background, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no people.

IMPORTANT COLOR: match the reference building's warm wood/stone/tile palette exactly -- do not brighten or desaturate.

ABSOLUTELY AVOID: smooth painterly rendering, soft gradients, watercolour blending, photorealism, glossy 3D render, black outlines, text, labels, a second building, people.

IMPORTANT: match the geometric faceted style, palette and mood of the attached reference exactly -- this must look like part of the same illustrated set.
subjectGuards: explicitly smaller/simpler than the reference (it is an annex, not a second main house)
exactly one building in frame -- reject if the model adds a second structure or a courtyard wall
hipped tile roof, not thatched or flat -- matches every other building in the estate
